notes: Pages studied are Campus France Maroc general pages and the Parcoursup page for the BUT GEA programme. The Parcoursup page is the programme's own page but concerns French/EU applicants; the tuition fee (178 EUR/year, and free for scholarship holders) and deadlines on it are not stated for the non-EU / foreign-diploma applicant, so tuition and intake deadlines are left out. The applicant mentioned as a student with a Moroccan Bac applies via Études en France / Campus France (applicationChannel and its deadline not stated here). The documents list is taken only from the Campus France 1ère année BUT page, which names no other required documents beyond the diploma.
